Description
As an NDC Admin,
I want to integrate and validate the Ancillaries feature within the AirIndia booking flow on NDC Portal [Uplift],
so that customers can successfully retrieve, select, and book ancillary services throughout the complete AirIndia booking process.

Description / Scope

This story aims to enable and verify the integration of the Ancillaries-[Meal & Baggage] feature into the AirIndia booking flow, ensuring that ancillary services supported by the supplier are available and function correctly throughout the end-to-end customer booking journey on NDC Portal [Uplift].


  • Supplier Checklist:
    • Attached
  • Bug Report:
    • Attached
Note:
Portal Uplift branch must be deployed on staging environment before QC team start testing.

Acceptance Criteria

1. End-to-End Flow Validation

Verify ancillaries behaviour across the following flow, wherever applicable:

  1. Search

  2. Fare Confirm

  3. Add PAX

  4. Get Ancillary

  5. Fare Check (optional) (Not Applicable)

  6. Booking Flow

    • Book → Hold → Book after Hold → Retrieve (with ancillaries)

2. Journey Types

  • Validate for One-way journeys

  • Validate for Round-trip journeys

  • Validate for Multi-city journeys

3. Functional Validation

  • Ancillaries are correctly retrieved and displayed

  • Selected ancillaries are correctly added to booking

  • Ancillary pricing is accurate and consistent across steps

  • Ancillaries persist correctly through:

    • Booking


Ancillaries for AirIndia must be reflected correctly in the following modules:

  1. Reports
  2. Itinerary 

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Ancillaries are successfully retrieved and applied for AirIndia.

  2. End-to-end booking flow works correctly with ancillaries included.

  3. Hold and Book after Hold flows function correctly with ancillaries.

  4. No data loss or inconsistency occurs between steps.

  5. Any defects are logged with clear reproduction steps.
